concepts.title: Refined Slate
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full Quader editor UI mockup, Refined Slate, folder-tab refinement.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. The complete Refined Slate concept; preserve all of it except the three dock title strips specified below.
Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE. The user's chosen small close-up showing the Face Texture dock's folder-shaped tab. Precisely transfer this unmistakable silhouette.

Primary request: Replace the full-width rectangular title bars of Outliner (upper left), Inspector (lower left), and Face Texture (right) with the folder-like attached tabs from image 2. The tab occupies only enough width for its title and small close glyph, at the LEFT end of a dark empty rail; NOT a full-width title bar. Each has a flat top, small softened upper corners, and a very clearly SLOPING RIGHT SHOULDER that descends all the way to the panel rim. Use a restrained lighter graphite surface compatible with this concept's palette. The active tab bottom merges into the panel frame without an underline or gap. Keep one thin top highlight for local sculpted depth and a quiet outer edge. Let the darker unused tab rail continue across the rest of the dock width. Preserve small undock glyphs discreetly. The title text must remain readable.
Specific intent: the user wants this distinctive classic folder-tab shape with the cleaner balanced control styling already in image 1. This is a narrowly targeted dock-chrome edit. Do not simplify the tabs into clipped rectangles. Do not make them modern pill buttons.
Invariants: preserve image 1's overall palette, unique toolbar grouping, button and field treatment, all panel positions and widths, Outliner contents, Inspector sections and fields, Face Texture canvas and UV controls, material thumbnails, window/menu/top toolbar, text, existing controls, scene geometry, camera, grid, colored selections, orange viewport border. Leave Inspector disclosure sections as they are; only the THREE main dock title strips become folder tabs. Do not move Inspector to right, add a bottom browser, change the viewport, add tabs or invent controls. Keep the full application screenshot framing, same aspect ratio and dark-only theme.
Avoid: exaggerated retro bevels, shiny plastic, noise, grunge, ornamental frames, extra nested borders, huge tab height, flat full-width title bars, new app features, labels outside the UI, concept-board framing.
